description:
When to fly a route for less: the cheapest day of each month, the cheapest day of the week, and how much
        the cheapest day saves against a typical day. Uses fares for this month and next.
        Use for "which day is cheapest to fly Islamabad to Riyadh" or "best time to book Karachi to Dubai".
name: cheapest_days
title: Cheapest days to fly
